Restarting and factory reset

To restart the router, unplug the power adapter, wait 30 seconds, and plug it back in. Restarting keeps all of your settings.

To restore factory settings, press and hold the recessed reset button on the back of the router with a paperclip for 10 seconds, until the light starts pulsing blue. A factory reset erases your Wi-Fi name, password, guest network, and parental controls, and you will need to set up the router again in the app.

Resetting the camera

To reset the QC2 to factory settings, press and hold the reset button underneath the camera for 5 seconds, until it plays a chime. You will then need to add the camera in the app again.

Resetting your password

On the sign-in screen of the Quillon Home app, tap Forgot password and enter your email address. We send you a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

Router and node errors

E-101: No WAN cable detected. Make sure the Ethernet cable from your modem is plugged into the yellow WAN port, not one of the grey LAN ports.

E-102: Internet login failed. Your internet provider uses PPPoE and rejected the username or password. Re-enter the PPPoE username and password from your provider under Settings, then Internet.

E-204: The router did not receive an IP address from the modem. Restart the modem first, wait two minutes, then restart the router.

E-310: A satellite node lost its connection to the router. Move the node closer to the router or to another node, then wait five minutes for it to reconnect.

E-4012: The cooling fan has stopped. Turn the router off and contact support to arrange a replacement under warranty. Do not leave the router running with a stopped fan.

E-5020: The power supply is overheating. Unplug the router for one hour, move it away from heat sources, and make sure the vents are not covered.

E-7001: A firmware update failed its integrity check. The router automatically keeps its previous firmware. The update is retried after 30 minutes; if it fails three times in a row, contact support.

Making a warranty claim

To make a claim, contact support with your order number or another proof of purchase and the serial number printed on the bottom of the device. If the claim is approved, we send a replacement and email you a prepaid label for returning the faulty device.

Secure Family subscribers can get an advance replacement: we ship the replacement before you send back the faulty device.

Coverage

Router and node errors
